interpretation: Every loss is an original NT24 read pair absent from all viral-protein candidates. Preparation uses AA12-screen FASTP output followed by unchanged human/other contaminant filters. Absence from prepared queries does not by itself identify which upstream operation removed it. Prepared queries without an eligible viral-protein call passed that boundary but lack an alignment satisfying the frozen protein criteria. Native AA12 assignment preservation is an additional observed comparison, not a presumed causal explanation. Linked NR evidence belongs to the explicitly identified exact-sequence control query. Control-status counts use unique control queries, not extrapolated verdicts for original reads. Other losses remain unvalidated.
